propositions: Three independent code paths (normal compaction, fsck rebuild, crash recovery) re-derive identical decisions for candidate listing, SNAPSHOT file detection, envelope building, and retired file restoration across separate modules
The SNAPSHOT envelope is built in two places (compact_txn and compact_rebuild) with duplicated logic including source_event_uuids and compacted_at key derivation
The retired file rename-back rule with its data-loss guard is implemented three times across compact_txn, compact_recovery, and rollback paths without centralized ownership
A rebuild with stray non-.json files in a ticket directory currently includes them in source_event_uuids and renames them to *.retired, violating the file format invariant
The two-arm needs-folding check (SNAPSHOT presence and foldable event count threshold) is duplicated across compact._scan_snapshot_state and compact_trigger.ticket_needs_folding
